notes: All accepted files are actual photographs or artwork reproductions acquired from official institutional sources. No Commons photograph is included.
Commons requests were spaced by at least 3.1 seconds and stopped upon the first HTTP 429. No retry or alternate Commons download followed.
Every accepted file was visually inspected and has an actual measured long edge of at least 800 pixels. No upscaling or image generation.
Null artist/date values mean not verified for the specific subject; construction or photograph dates are not inferred.
All rights.publicationCleared values are false. Source access is not a publication license; parent integration must retain rights checks.
The assets directory and assets array are the deliverable selection. Other evidence/candidate files are not approved alternatives.
